record.question: A 25-year-old engineering graduate from Odhisa has recently become the youngest MP. Who is she?
record.explanation: Answer A: Chandrani Murmu. Chandrani Murmu, age 25, won the Keonjhar Lok Sabha constituency in 2019; the Election Commission’s results identify her as the winner. “Youngest MP” is a contemporaneous claim, and age 25 makes her the youngest elected member in that election. Reference: https://results.eci.gov.in/pc/en/constituencywise/ConstituencywiseS181.htm?ac=1. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
